title: Position pl display stuck at 0 recurred mid-week, outside the weekend-reopen window FLAG-004 was scoped to
detail: Position 109848667 (Sell USDJPY 0.01L [LEARN], entry 163.392, opened tick153 ~07:34 UTC) showed get_open_positions().pl == 0 at tick155 read time (~08:00 UTC, Monday, normal London-session trading, NOT a weekend reopen). Real economics computed from live bid/ask at read time: adverse move of ~12.8pips (163.392 entry vs ~163.52 ask), worth roughly -R14 at 0.01 lots. Position was closed moments later via Rule5 cut at 163.532, and get_close_positions confirmed actual realized pl -R14.34 -- matching the manually-computed estimate, not the displayed 0. FLAG-004 (resolved tick147) attributed the same symptom specifically to weekend-reopen mark-to-market lag; this occurrence during ordinary Monday London-session trading, ~26min after a normal market-hours open, shows the display bug is not limited to weekend reopens as previously concluded.
impact: Undermines FLAG-004's resolution scope (weekend-reopen-only). Learn mode's entire purpose is building a trustworthy [LEARN] outcome dataset for later Rule17/H4-override analysis -- if live pl reads cannot be trusted intraday, any tick that uses displayed pl (rather than manually cross-checking bid/ask) to make a Rule5/13/14 management decision risks acting on stale/wrong numbers. This tick caught it only because the M5 structure call was made independently of the displayed pl figure.
classification: data_integrity - display/marking lag, broader than previously scoped; execution path (SL/TP orders, close fills) still appears correct based on this one sample
recommendation: Evan to check whether get_open_positions().pl lags real-time mark-to-market generally (not just on weekend reopen) -- e.g. whether it only refreshes on some interval or event. Until confirmed, auto-tick runs should keep cross-checking open-position pl against live bid/ask before relying on it for Rule5/13/14 calls, as done this tick.
